description: December 21 birthday meaning: Sagittarius or Capricorn cusp, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, December 21 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Sagittarius or Capricorn. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: December 21 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Born near the winter solstice, December 21 can belong to either Sagittarius or Capricorn depending on year and time. In most years the Sun is in the final degree of Sagittarius. The birthday number 3 adds creativity and humour. Taken together, the blend pairs big-picture optimism with emerging seriousness: a cheerful realist who jokes their way through hard work.

On December 21 the Sun usually sits at about 29° Sagittarius, in the third decan, where Sun is the sub-ruler alongside Jupiter. Birthdays around December 20 to December 22 fall on the Sagittarius–Capricorn cusp, near the December solstice. Mutable fire meets cardinal earth, and optimism meets ambition. Which sign the Sun was actually in depends on the year, time and birthplace, as the moment of ingress varies; a chart for your exact details is the way to confirm it. Those who carry both energies are often described as visionaries with a plan, people who dream large and then build methodically. They may swing between restlessness and serious focus, and both modes tend to serve them.

sections.heading: December 21 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 21st, your compound reduces as 2 + 1 = 3. Unlike the 12th, where the individual comes first, here the 2 of partnership leads and the 1 follows, which numerologists sometimes read as creativity that grows out of relationships. The resulting 3 is expressive, social and optimistic. Twenty-first-born people are often described as charming and versatile, able to bring people together and make collaborative projects enjoyable. As a supporting number, the 21 tends to show in how easily they connect. Seeing a shared project through to the end can be their most valued contribution.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one December 21 birthday to the next: it is 4 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on December 21: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: December birthdays arrive at the start of northern winter, around the shortest days and the year's festivities, and at the start of summer in the southern hemisphere. Sagittarius holds most of the month, with Capricorn beginning around December 21 or 22. In numerology December is month 12, which reduces to 3: expression and sociability, built from the 1 and 2 of initiative and partnership. December 21 is the 355th day of the year (356th in a leap year). By December 22, 1 day later, the Sun has usually moved on into Capricorn.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by December 21, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on December 21 include Emmanuel Macron (1977), Benjamin Disraeli (1804) and Jane Fonda (1937).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is December 21?
faq.answer: December 21 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Sagittarius or Capricorn on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Sagittarius. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on December 21?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On December 21 the Life Path is 4 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 21st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on December 21?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a December 21 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on December 21?
faq.answer: December 21 is also the birthday of Emmanuel Macron (1977), Benjamin Disraeli (1804) and Jane Fonda (1937). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
